The '''Vile Grotto''' was a cave located in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]], five [[Voss commandos]]&mdash;[[Vara-Sol]], [[Akana-Tok]], [[Norus-Wel]], [[Chalak-Ka]], and [[Suvar-Ton]]&mdash;defied [[Voss (species)|Voss]] law and entered the Nightmare Lands, only to be driven insane by [[Sel-Makor]]. Physically enhanced by the region's dark energies and capable of commanding corrupted beasts, the group took up residence in the Vile Grotto, from which they spread the Nightmare Lands' corruption. As a result, the Voss recruited outsiders to enter the Nightmare Lands and kill the corrupted commandos.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vile Grotto appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is the site of the Imperial Heroic mission "Darker Than Dark."<ref name="TOR" />
